entries.title: Proverbs 18:1
segments: ¶Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh [and] intermeddleth with all wisdom. {Through...: or, He that separateth himself seeketh according to his desire, and intermeddleth in every business}

words.text: . {Through...: or, He that separateth himself seeketh according to his desire, and intermeddleth in every business}

entries.title: Proverbs 18:2
segments: ¶A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:3
segments: ¶When the wicked cometh, [then] cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:4
segments: ¶The words of a man's mouth [are as] deep waters, [and] the wellspring of wisdom [as] a flowing brook.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:5
segments: ¶[It is] not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:6
segments: ¶A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:7
segments: A fool's mouth [is] his destruction, and his lips [are] the snare of his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:8
segments: ¶The words of a talebearer [are] as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly. {talebearer: or, whisperer} {as wounds: or, like as when men are wounded} {most...: Heb. chambers}

words.text: . {talebearer: or, whisperer} {as wounds: or, like as when men are wounded} {most...: Heb. chambers}

entries.title: Proverbs 18:9
segments: ¶He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

words.text: to him that is a great

entries.title: Proverbs 18:10
segments: ¶The name of the LORD [is] a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe. {safe: Heb. set aloft}

entries.title: Proverbs 18:11
segments: ¶The rich man's wealth [is] his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:12
segments: ¶Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour [is] humility.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:13
segments: ¶He that answereth a matter before he heareth [it], it [is] folly and shame unto him. {answereth...: Heb. returneth a word}

words.text: unto him. {answereth...: Heb. returneth a word}

entries.title: Proverbs 18:14
segments: ¶The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

entries.title: Proverbs 18:15
segments: ¶The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:16
segments: ¶A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:17
segments: ¶[He that is] first in his own cause [seemeth] just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:18
segments: ¶The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:19
segments: ¶A brother offended [is harder to be won] than a strong city: and [their] contentions [are] like the bars of a castle.

words.text: [is harder to be won] than a strong

entries.title: Proverbs 18:20
segments: ¶A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; [and] with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:21
segments: ¶Death and life [are] in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:22
segments: ¶[Whoso] findeth a wife findeth a good [thing], and obtaineth favour of the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:23
segments: ¶The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:24
segments: ¶A man [that hath] friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend [that] sticketh closer than a brother.
